natural: A face like a flower, looks like the moon

meaning.en: Beautiful as a flower; a lovely face (of women).
meaning.zh: 像花一样的容貌，像月一样的美貌。形容女子美丽。

examples.zh: 她花容月貌，追求者很多。
examples.en: She's a real beauty with many admirers.

examples.zh: 岁月带走了她的花容月貌，却带不走她的气质。
examples.en: Time has taken her youthful beauty but not her grace.

meaning.en: (Of a teacher) to mislead students through incompetence.
meaning.zh: 指教师不称职，耽误了学生的前途。

examples.zh: 不负责任的老师会误人子弟。
examples.en: Irresponsible teachers lead students astray.

examples.zh: 我水平有限，怕误人子弟。
examples.en: I'm not that good — I'm afraid I'd do my students a disservice.

usage.en: Predicate. Also used modestly by teachers.

meaning.en: A cornered enemy will fight desperately.
meaning.zh: 被围困的野兽还要作最后挣扎。比喻在绝境中还要竭力抵抗。

examples.zh: 敌人已是困兽犹斗，不足为惧。
examples.en: The enemy is a cornered beast making a last stand — nothing to fear.

examples.zh: 困兽犹斗，我们要小心他们的反扑。
examples.en: A cornered animal fights hardest — beware their counter-attack.

story.en: Advising against attacking a defeated enemy commander, a Jin officer warned: "Even a trapped beast fights — how much more a chief minister!"

natural: A dream under the southern branch

meaning.en: An empty dream; fleeting glory that vanishes.
meaning.zh: 形容一场大梦，或比喻空欢喜。

examples.zh: 他的发财梦不过是南柯一梦。
examples.en: His dream of getting rich was just a pipe dream.

examples.zh: 荣华富贵，转眼成了南柯一梦。
examples.en: Wealth and glory turned to an empty dream in an instant.

story.en: Chunyu Fen fell asleep under a locust tree and dreamt he married a princess and governed Nanke for twenty years. On waking he found the kingdom was an ant nest under the tree's southern branch.
story.zh: 淳于棼在槐树下睡着，梦见做了大槐安国驸马，任南柯太守二十年。醒来发现所谓国家原是槐树南枝下的蚁穴。

usage.en: Object. In speech 一 is yí.

meaning.en: Expressing sorrow with restraint.
meaning.zh: 悲哀而不过分。形容诗歌、音乐优美雅致，感情有节制。

examples.zh: 这首诗哀而不伤，耐人寻味。
examples.en: The poem is poignant yet restrained, and rewards rereading.

examples.zh: 这段音乐哀而不伤，十分动人。
examples.en: The music is melancholy but measured, and very moving.

story.en: Confucius praised the poem "Guanju": "joyful but not licentious, sorrowful but not harrowing" (乐而不淫，哀而不伤).
story.zh: 《论语·八佾》："《关雎》乐而不淫，哀而不伤。"

usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于艺术评价。

meaning.en: Vindictive; avenging the smallest slight.
meaning.zh: 像瞪一下眼睛那样极小的怨恨也要报复。形容心胸极其狭窄。

examples.zh: 他睚眦必报，得罪不起。
examples.en: He's vindictive — you can't afford to cross him.

examples.zh: 做人要大度，不能睚眦必报。
examples.en: Be magnanimous — don't avenge every slight.

story.en: Fan Ju, after rising to power, "repaid every meal's kindness and avenged every angry glare" (一饭之德必偿，睚眦之怨必报).
story.zh: 范雎得势后，"一饭之德必偿，睚眦之怨必报"。

meaning.en: Two-faced; double-dealing.
meaning.zh: 比喻耍两面派手法，当面一套，背后一套。

examples.zh: 他两面三刀，当面说好话，背后使坏。
examples.en: He's two-faced — nice to your face, backstabbing behind your back.

examples.zh: 跟两面三刀的人打交道要小心。
examples.en: Be careful dealing with double-dealers.

synonyms: 见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话

meaning.en: Birds of a feather; all equally bad.
meaning.zh: 同一个山丘上的貉。比喻彼此同是丑类，没有什么差别。

examples.zh: 这两个骗子是一丘之貉。
examples.en: These two conmen are birds of a feather.

examples.zh: 他们官商勾结，一丘之貉。
examples.en: The officials and businessmen are tarred with the same brush.

story.en: Yang Yun, criticising rulers past and present, said: "Ancient and modern are like badgers from the same hill" — no different.
story.zh: 杨恽说："古与今如一丘之貉。"

usage.zh: 多作宾语，贬义。"貉"读 hé。

natural: Treating the people like fish and meat

meaning.en: To prey on and oppress the common people.
meaning.zh: 把百姓当作鱼和肉一样任意宰割。指残暴地欺凌压迫人民。

examples.zh: 贪官污吏鱼肉百姓。
examples.en: Corrupt officials prey on the people.

examples.zh: 恶霸鱼肉百姓，无恶不作。
examples.en: The local tyrant oppressed the people and committed every crime.

natural: Showing off an axe at Lu Ban's door

meaning.en: To show off before an expert (often said modestly of oneself).
meaning.zh: 在鲁班门前玩弄斧子。比喻在行家面前卖弄本领。

equivalents: teach your grandmother to suck eggs
show off in front of an expert

examples.zh: 在您面前讲书法，我是班门弄斧了。
examples.en: Talking about calligraphy in front of you is teaching my grandmother to suck eggs.

examples.zh: 他在专家面前班门弄斧，闹了笑话。
examples.en: He showed off in front of experts and made a fool of himself.

story.en: A Ming poet mocked visitors who scribbled poems on Li Bai's tomb: "Who dares to show off an axe at Lu Ban's door?" — Lu Ban being the legendary master carpenter.
story.zh: 梅之涣讥讽在李白墓前题诗的人："来的去的写两行，鲁班门前弄大斧。"

synonyms: 关公面前耍大刀——自不量力

meaning.en: Good-looking but without substance.
meaning.zh: 空有好看的外表，实际上不行。

equivalents: all fur coat and no knickers

examples.zh: 这家公司虚有其表，实力很弱。
examples.en: The company is all show and no substance.

examples.zh: 别看他长得帅，其实虚有其表。
examples.en: He may look good, but there's nothing behind it.

synonyms: 张飞卖豆腐——人硬货不硬

meaning.en: Kindred spirits; congenial.
meaning.zh: 志趣和性格相同的人，彼此投合。

examples.zh: 他们俩意气相投，成了好朋友。
examples.en: They hit it off and became good friends.

examples.zh: 一群意气相投的年轻人组建了乐队。
examples.en: A group of like-minded young people formed a band.

meaning.en: To harm someone through a third party.
meaning.zh: 比喻自己不出面，借别人的手去害人。

equivalents: get someone else to do one's dirty work

examples.zh: 他借刀杀人，利用别人整垮了对手。
examples.en: He got others to do his dirty work and ruined his rival.

examples.zh: 借刀杀人是三十六计之一。
examples.en: Killing with a borrowed knife is one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.

story.en: The third of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: when the enemy is clear but an ally wavers, induce the ally to strike, preserving one's own strength.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第三计："敌已明，友未定，引友杀敌，不自出力。"

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

natural: A four-horse chariot can't catch it

meaning.en: A word once spoken can't be taken back; one must keep one's word.
meaning.zh: 话一说出口，就是套上四匹马拉的车也难追上。指话说出来就收不回。

examples.zh: 一言既出，驷马难追，我说到做到。
examples.en: A promise is a promise — I'll do what I said.

examples.zh: 君子一言，驷马难追。
examples.en: A gentleman's word, once given, can't be taken back.

story.en: Zigong said: "A four-horse team cannot catch the tongue" (驷不及舌) — careless words cannot be recalled.

usage.en: Usually 一言既出，驷马难追 or 君子一言，驷马难追.
usage.zh: 常说"一言既出，驷马难追"。

meaning.en: Great ambition.
meaning.zh: 鸿鹄：天鹅。比喻远大志向。

examples.zh: 燕雀安知鸿鹄之志哉？
examples.en: How can sparrows know the ambitions of the swan?

examples.zh: 他从小就有鸿鹄之志。
examples.en: He's had lofty ambitions since childhood.

story.en: As a hired farmhand, Chen She told his mocking companions: "How can swallows and sparrows know the ambitions of the swan?" He later led the first rebellion against Qin.
story.zh: 陈涉为人佣耕时说："燕雀安知鸿鹄之志哉！"后来领导了反秦起义。

meaning.en: Saying nothing of substance.
meaning.zh: 文章或言论空空洞洞，没有内容。

examples.zh: 他的讲话言之无物。
examples.en: His speech was all hot air.

examples.zh: 写文章最忌言之无物。
examples.en: The worst thing in writing is having nothing to say.

natural: A family with the fragrance of books

meaning.en: A family of scholars; a cultured family.
meaning.zh: 指上辈有读书人的人家。

examples.zh: 她出身书香门第，从小爱读书。
examples.en: From a family of scholars, she has loved reading since childhood.

examples.zh: 他家三代都是教师，可谓书香门第。
examples.en: Three generations of teachers — truly a family of scholars.

usage.en: Object, often 出身书香门第.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说"出身书香门第"。

meaning.en: Extraordinarily talented (especially in writing).
meaning.zh: 比喻人极有才华。

examples.zh: 曹植才高八斗。
examples.en: Cao Zhi was a literary genius.

examples.zh: 他才高八斗，学富五车。
examples.en: He's immensely talented and deeply learned.

story.en: The poet Xie Lingyun said: "If all the talent in the world were one dan (ten dou), Cao Zijian (Cao Zhi) alone would have eight dou, I one, and everyone else one."
story.zh: 谢灵运说："天下才有一石，曹子建独占八斗，我得一斗，天下共分一斗。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 学富五车.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"学富五车"连用。

meaning.en: Insatiable in learning.
meaning.zh: 学习总不满足。形容好学。

examples.zh: 学而不厌，诲人不倦。
examples.en: Never tire of learning, never weary of teaching.

examples.zh: 他学而不厌，七十岁还在学外语。
examples.en: A lifelong learner, he's still studying languages at seventy.

story.en: Confucius: "To silently store knowledge, to learn without tiring, to teach without wearying — what difficulty do these give me?"
story.zh: 《论语·述而》："默而识之，学而不厌，诲人不倦，何有于我哉？"

usage.en: Predicate. Often with 诲人不倦.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与"诲人不倦"连用。

meaning.en: Incredibly stupid. (Originally: feigning foolishness wisely.)
meaning.zh: 原指人为了避祸装傻，别人赶不上。现形容极其愚蠢。

equivalents: dumb as a box of rocks

examples.zh: 这种做法简直愚不可及。
examples.en: That approach is incredibly stupid.

examples.zh: 他为了一点小利丢了工作，真是愚不可及。
examples.en: Losing his job for a tiny gain — beyond stupid.

story.en: Confucius praised Ning Wuzi, who played the fool when the state was in chaos: "His wisdom can be matched; his foolishness cannot" (其愚不可及也).
story.zh: 孔子评宁武子："邦有道则知，邦无道则愚。其知可及也，其愚不可及也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Negative today, though originally praise.

meaning.en: A nobody; an unknown.
meaning.zh: 没有名气的小兵。比喻没有名气的人。

examples.zh: 我只是个无名小卒，谁会听我的？
examples.en: I'm just a nobody — who'd listen to me?

examples.zh: 十年前他还是个无名小卒。
examples.en: Ten years ago he was an unknown.

meaning.en: To follow one's predecessor's established policies.
meaning.zh: 萧何制定的规章制度，曹参继续执行。比喻按前人的成规办事。

equivalents: if it ain't broke, don't fix it

examples.zh: 新领导萧规曹随，没有大改。
examples.en: The new leader kept his predecessor's policies without major changes.

examples.zh: 萧规曹随有时也是明智的选择。
examples.en: Continuity can sometimes be the wise choice.

story.en: When Cao Can succeeded Xiao He as chancellor of Han, he changed nothing, saying Xiao's laws were clear and complete; the people praised the stability.
story.zh: 曹参接替萧何为相，一切遵照萧何制定的法规，百姓称颂。
